title: Biferous
summary: BIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin bifer, biferus; of bis, twice, and fero, to bear.] Bearing fruit twice a year, as plants do in warm climates.

inlines.v: BIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin bifer, biferus; of bis, twice, and fero, to bear.] Bearing fruit twice a year, as plants do in warm climates.
